videos.headline: James Madison strikes first with 14-yard touchdown
videos.description: Bryan Schor hits Jonathan Kloosterman over the middle for the touchdown to put James Madison up 7-0 late in the first quarter.

videos.headline: JMU extends lead with Abdullah TD, stunning NDSU crowd
videos.description: Bryan Schor scrambles out and finds Khalid Abdullah wide-open who gets into the end zone to extend James Madison's lead to 17-0 and silencing the crowd in Fargo.

videos.headline: North Dakota State ties the game on a 16-yard TD run
videos.description: King Frazier takes the handoff and scoots through the defense to score from 16 yards out, making it 17 unanswered points for North Dakota State and tying the game in the third quarter.
